claim: As automorphisms of the Niemeier A8^3 lattice VOA, the three two-qutrit Pauli groups generate ONE extraspecial group 3^(1+12): the glue code reduces mod 3 to the diagonal <(1,1,1)>, so the three SU(9) centres act identically on every sector and the product is central. Its commutator form is the orthogonal sum of three W(3,3) forms. The group fixes nothing in V_1 = sl9^3, whereas every cyclic subgroup fixes 26 dimensions per factor, and by Kreknin every finite-order automorphism of a semisimple V_1 has fixed points. So no cyclic orbifold of V_{A8^3} is Moonshine, and a non-cyclic 3^(1+12) - the shape of O_3 of the Monster 3B normaliser - is the only kind of symmetry that can empty V_1.
openProblem: Construct the 3^(1+12) orbifold of V_{A8^3}: its anomaly class, its twisted sectors and their weight-one states. If it exists, is holomorphic and has V_1 = 0, the FLM uniqueness conjecture identifies it with V^natural.
status: items 1-3 proved and verified; item 4 is a structural identification, not a construction
